description: Fir Extract FIR 126/2024, PS Division-4 at PS Division-4 (Patiala): Cheating, Fraud & Forgery

metadata.text: [Public record · High Court of Punjab and Haryana, CRM-M-60009-2024, order dated 2025-05-19 · names pseudonymised] Facts as recorded in the order: 3. That brief facts of the case are that case/FIR No. 126 dated 08.10.2024 u/s 406, 420 IPC at Police Station Division No. 4, Patiala against [Person X3] (Brother of accused/petitioner) [Person X4] (accused/petitioner) and [Name W1] son of [Name W2] son of [Person X1] residents of [address withheld] District Malerkotla on the basis applications moved by complainant [Complainant C1] son of [Person X2], resident of [address withheld]. 1, Nihal Bag, Patiala, before the Senior Superintendent of Police Patiala. The detail of which is as follows:- i) An application 30.06.2023 No. moved 7044/[Name W3] by moved complainant [Complainant C1] son dated by of [Person X2], resident of [address withheld]. 1, Nihal Bag, Patiala, against accused/petitioner [Accused A2], before the Senior Superintendent of Police Patiala, in which he alleged that accused/petitioner [Accused A2], on 31.05.2022, has mortgaged his land situated at Village [withheld], Tehsil & District Malerkotla, with the complainant, for amount of Rs. 10 [Name W4] and agreed to return the said amount on or before 01.06.2023 and in case of failure, he would execute the sale deed of said land. At that time, [Accused A2] also handed over the possession of the land to the complainant. However, [Accused A2] did not return the amount till 01.06.2023 and on asking of the complainant, [Accused A2] agreed to execute the sale deed in his favour. Court proceedings: petition for anticipatory bail by [Accused A1], [Accused A2]; outcome: Allowed.
